messages:
dara: FYI us-2 NVMe pipeline congestion - attach retries + pod pending spiked after a midnight checkpoint wave. infra-bot fired.
infra-bot: [ALERT] nvme_pipeline_congestion > 300 (us-2) - 14m sustained. dash: /dash/nvme-pipeline-us-2. runbook: /runbooks/pipeline-backpressure.md
kevin: seeing a pattern: model worker checkpoint bursts (KV writebacks) + janitor trim spikes. controllers report queue stall and a couple of read-only events. pending GPU pods ~48.
nora: scrub_concurrency in us-2 was bumped to 10 to clear backlog earlier. checkpointer had default ckpt_freq=15s which floods small writes.
sylvie: immediate fix: reduce checkpointer frequency and move trim to deferred mode. can hotpatch env in region.
dara: paste commands for regional hotfix.
sylvie: run these in infra-us-2 namespace:
```
kubectl set env deployment/model-checkpointer CKPT_FREQ=60 -n infra-us-2
kubectl set env deployment/janitor TRIM_MODE=deferred -n infra-us-2
kubectl scale deployment/janitor --replicas=1 -n infra-us-2
```
kevin: applying now, will watch pipeline metric and attach queue.
[kevin reacts :eyes:]
infra-bot: [ACTION] janitor env patched by kevin (TRIM_MODE=deferred)
kevin: initial signal: pipeline congestion index 340 -> 95 in ~8m, pending GPUs 48 -> 7. attach retries dropping.
nora: also enabling local write-coalescing on checkpointers (config flip) to batch small KV writes - pushing config shortly.
dara: good. short-term spill option if attach doesn't recover: route 12% of new GPU launches to dedicated-us-east for 2h. cost estimate?
billing-bot: est added infra delta ~$125/hr for 12% spill to dedicated-us-east. finance auto-approve threshold is $200/hr.
sylvie: prefer to avoid spill. keep throttles for 45m and monitor wear backlog. we will also increase janitor backoff thresholds and add a fast-fail path for checkpointer when nvme_io>80%.
kevin: monitoring shows stable after 20m. will keep heightened alerts 3h. filing ticket for adaptive checkpointer + pipeline-aware janitor: /tickets/INF-7703.
dara: schedule retro with checkpointer, janitor, scheduler owners tomorrow 09:00am. nice quick patch everyone. :thumbsup:
sylvie: follow-ups: propose RFC for per-region checkpoint windows and write-coalescing defaults. will draft.
kevin: reverting TRIM_MODE and CKPT_FREQ to defaults only after 2h stability and backlog checks. closing unless regressions appear.
